scope: Explicit causal head-group control; default1 and automatic GPU selection unchanged. Full A40 qualification only; values2/8 and other GPUs need their own qualification.
numerical_policy: Unchanged single-rounded P/dS, FP32 products/actual-output delta/gradients, separate unscaled maximum and log2 normalization, late gradient scale.
timing_scope: Same-process alternating graph replay and complete eager calls; forward retains gradients.
event_scope: The eager CUDA-event interval includes launch gaps; graph replay is a separate device-path control.
